description: Get a document revision including its body and lock_version for review. Table-bearing blocks are preserved as read-only HTML in content_markdown, not round-trippable Markdown. Edit those bodies in the ClearPolicy editor or omit body_markdown when copying them to a new draft. Use the latest_draft_revision_id or latest_published_revision_id from create-document-tool or get-document-tool.

revision_id.description: The ULID of the document revision.

name: get-document-revision-tool
title: Get Document Revision
